title: Our economy doesn’t work without immigration. name: Lium
title: RT by @lium_io: I set up @lium_io [SN51] today for some GPU compute I need for a project. I've used a fair few GPU providers at this point, and this was probably the smoothest setup I've had. Created an account, topped up with $TAO, generated an API key and handed the docs to my agent. A few minutes later it was spinning up GPUs. The part I really liked is how agent-friendly everything is. llms.txt, clean docs, JSON output, budget caps and TTLs. There was no fighting with dashboards or figuring out some obscure API. Well done to the team. This is how infrastructure should be built now.
